reply.analysis: Nothing exact is proven. Verdict is gap: beta in [336, 537]. The lower bound is a checked independent set of 336 and the upper bound is a checked clique cover of 537 cliques. No linear code helped: the one code tried, (p=2, c=1), had length above 536, and codes_tried stayed at 1, so the spectral step added no code. Against the 120 s baselines the agent's bracket is tighter on both sides: lower 336 vs 294 (cpsat_alpha) and 293 (f2_minrank_sat, kushagra_agent), upper 537 vs 998 (kushagra_agent) and 994 (frac_cover). It also took less time, 94.3 s wall (47.1 s of it LLM time) against about 120 s. f2_minrank_sat was faster (0.79 s) but only reached 293. One oddity: frac_cover 994 is far above the integral cover of 537, so that LP baseline must have stopped early.
